groups.title: Beat 5 · Step 4 — score the dev split

beats.label: Run the compiled scorer
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The bundle drives the real runEval.” runId, pass rate, and the 95% interval beside it — because at n=2 the point estimate alone is a lie.
beats.script: “The bundle drives the real runEval.” runId, pass rate, and the 95% interval beside it — because at n=2 the point estimate alone is a lie. [[pause:1.8s]] This is a live, credentialed step and is intentionally excluded from offline replay. Needs Anthropic credentials — one model call per sample. Reports passRate with a Wilson interval and meanScore with a Student-t interval, and omits them rather than fabricating when n is too small.

verify.note: needs Anthropic credentials — one model call per sample. Reports passRate with a Wilson interval and meanScore with a Student-t interval, and omits them rather than fabricating when n is too small

groups.title: One more thing · Step 9 — size the dataset before you pay for it

beats.label: Ask what n it would actually take
beats.cue: “Six samples told us the harness works. This tells us what it would cost to believe the number: 385 samples for ±5 points, and 769 if you want to compare two runs.”
beats.script: Six samples told us the harness works. This tells us what it would cost to believe the number: 385 samples for ±5 points, and 769 if you want to compare two runs. [[pause:1.5s]] This command is replayable offline, so its result is part of the repository's machine-checked demo contract. Pure arithmetic, no model and no dataset needed. Measured: n = 385 at 95%/±5pp worst-case p=0.5, ~769 per run for a two-run comparison, and it says out loud that it sizes an estimate's width, not a test's power.
